proofs.text: Read `skills/spec/SKILL.md`; verify it carries `origin/main`, `ids.next_ids` and `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/mcp`, and that the sentence naming `origin/main` also names the working tree as what ids are not allocated against. Removing the `ids.next_ids` fence fails naming `ids.next_ids`

rule_text: The skill allocates rule and proof ids against `origin/main` with the `ids.next_ids` helper under `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/mcp`, never against the working tree

tests.body:
def test_it_allocates_ids_against_the_default_branch(self):
        assert carries(skill_path('spec'), [
            'ids.next_ids', '${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/mcp',
            'allocated against `origin/main`, not against the working tree']) == []
tests.name: test_it_allocates_ids_against_the_default_branch
